request: Use the owner-selected characters-and-props render as the game start screen.
implementation: Preserve the supplied PNG bytes and original aspect ratio.
Render through a camera-space canvas to preserve the reference colors in the linear-color project.
Keep menu controls in DreamHUD: start, chapter selection, sound toggle and control hints.
Disable the backdrop during gameplay and allocate it only when starting at the menu.
visual_inspection: 1440x900: full composition, readable controls, Timmy/dragon/cauldron visible.
1920x1080: full composition with matching side margins.
1280x960: full composition with matching top and bottom margins.
After start: gameplay visible without the cover overlay.
iterations: Initial IMGUI rendering caused washed-out color. A color-correction attempt over-darkened the sky. Both were discarded. The final camera-space canvas matches the source sky RGB exactly in the three captured aspect ratios.
scope_limits: Automated checks and assistant screenshot inspection; no independent human playtest.
Local build only; no GitHub synchronization this turn.
